opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid participation in pooled Bitcoin mining, telling viewers to “put in a little bit of money to start buying the equipment and start mining Bitcoin on our own.” It then presents extraordinary returns, claiming that members “have already made millions of dollars” and that failing to become a millionaire within three years would be the viewer’s fault. This is an active solicitation rather than neutral education, reinforced by the instruction to “please do not wait three years to take this series” and the supplied sponsor link for the promoted BitClub opportunity.
